moving_core: The exact center is interior to the simple original filled outer. Exact point-to-segment squared distances prove a closed disk around it lies inside that outer. Every vertex of the convex integer core lies strictly inside this disk, so the complete core does too. Rotating the original around its origin and translating it moves the disk center to R*C+t while leaving the disk itself rotationally invariant. Thus the same world-aligned core is contained at every real cog angle. Holes remain reserved under common-line PIH off.
fixed_core: Exact rational ray parity for every rectangle corner and clipping against every transformed source edge prove each closed rectangle lies strictly inside its original filled outer. The parent 12 source placements are independently valid. Every case removes precisely its named bracket and keeps the other 11 exact source poses.
forbidden_centers: For a fixed rectangle and the moving convex core, the exact convex hull of all vertex differences is their no-fit polygon, including contact. Any center in that hull makes the contained closed shapes intersect, which contradicts the required positive gap between their original filled outers. No extra gap is imposed in this necessary test.
coverage: The outward-rounded bounds contain every continuous source-valid cog center. Every tree child pair exactly partitions its parent rational rectangle. Every leaf has all four corners inside one convex no-fit polygon, proved by exact cross-products, hence its complete area is forbidden. Every node is reachable exactly once and all leaves are covered. No placement coordinate discretization or sampled-angle assumption is used.
scope: All six fixed 11-part short-sheet configurations exclude adding a cog at any real angle and continuous center, even before the additional insert. More existing poses must change to pursue the 5-bracket/6-insert/2-cog allocation. This does not exclude that allocation, any other fixed layout, or the complete original job.
